_doc: DEV-OWNED hardware slotmap. palette.txt owns colors + ramp rows (artist); this file owns ramp -> slot numbers (dev). Slot semantics follow UI_COLOR_* in src/ui/ui.h and never move: 0 NONE/gray, 1 FIRE, 2 IRON, 3 FIELD/ground, 4 POISON/accent, 5 WOOD, 6 GOLD/light, 7 DIM/dark. Ramps ARE movable: to change what a slot shows, rename here. Aliases (one ramp in two slots) are honest duplicates of real artist colors. Ramps defined in palette.txt but absent here have no hardware slot and are reported, never invented.

forest._why: 3/0 ground=field1 (27 tiles); 1 fire=field6; 2/4 dark-green=field2; 5/6 stump-wood=field3/field4; 7 rocks=field5

desolate_landscape._why: 7/3/4/6 ground=desolate1 (36 tiles, floor slot 7); 1 fire=desolate3; 0/2/5 rocks=desolate2

castle._why: 0/3/7 stone-ground=castle4 (14 tiles, floor slot 0); 1/6 curtain-gold=castle3; 5 wood=castle2; 2/4 stairs=castle1 (0 tiles, real colors)

village._why: 5 ground-fence=town1 (18 tiles, merchant NPC); 6 houses=town2 (14 tiles, mayor NPC); 3 fence=town6 (guard/wizard/dog NPC); 1 fire=town3; 0/2 stone=town4/town5; 7 house-wall=town7; 4 = PAPER slot (UI_COLOR_PAPER): ui_draw_dialogue re-programs it to a white/black ramp, so NO world tile may use it (enforced by tools/verify_palette_manifest.py); it holds town4 as an inert placeholder

base._why: 0 frames/timer-bar=fight1; 1 fire=fight4 (HP heart red, burn text red); 2 ice=fight6 (freeze text blue); 3 field=fight3 (AP, deck icons: white+outline+brown cells); 4 poison=fight5 (poison text purple); 5 wood=fight2 (weapon icons incl. green-gem ring, arrow counters, digits: brown on tan); 6 text=fightspider (menu/coin text black-on-white; knife-grey echoes old text ramp); 7 dim=fightboss (grey-out). Unslotted: fightgoblin/fightspider/fightmimic/fightslime (battle sheet encoding via combat_art obj_palettes), fightbat, fightboss2/3.

obj._why: 0 shared OW (hero/bat/kobold/spider); 1 mimic OW (sprites5 exact); 2 selected-card rider ice/poison (sprites12 exact); 3 slime OW; 4 boss OW + rider fire (sprites2 exact for both; slot 4 is never reprogrammed by battle); 5 wizard (sprites7 exact); 6 merchant + dog OW (sprites9 exact for merchant, tan-exact for dogs with red collar nearest-matched); 7 mayor+guard (sprites8 exact; restored with NPC ramps on overworld return). Unslotted: sprites10 (dog-exact, no free OBJ slot) plus battle OAM art (combat_art obj_palettes, slotless by design).

title._why: Title logo encodes with title_logo; the title screen programs the ramp directly (title_content.c). Slot 1 matches the logo image palette.
